YI_Qptari55LcyyUgi1Dew.zh: 約旦扎爾卡(Zarqa)區域7/13報告138例病例,病患皆於某餐廳用餐後發病,目前仍有28例需住院觀察,無死亡病例報告。 當局已要求餐廳暫時停業,並調查感染源。另該國於2020年曾爆發單一餐廳的沙門氏菌感染症群聚事件。
YI_Qptari55LcyyUgi1Dew.en: Zarqa Governorate in Jordan reported 138 cases on 13 July. All patients fell ill after dining at a certain restaurant. Currently, 28 cases still require hospital observation, and no deaths have been reported. Authorities have ordered the restaurant to close temporarily and are investigating the source of infection. The country also experienced a Salmonella cluster linked to a single restaurant in 2020.
